name: Ancient City of Ping Yao
description: Pingyao is a walled town in central Shanxi, China, laid out in the 14th century and still holding its original street plan. Walking its lanes, you pass old courtyard homes, shopfronts and temples that are genuine Ming and Qing buildings, not reconstructions. In the 19th century it was the country's leading banking centre, and its grand financial houses remain a highlight.
